newsitem.title: USA: TCF Financial authorizes share issue.
newsitem.headline: TCF Financial authorizes share issue.

text.p: TCF Financial Corp said Tuesday it authorized the issue of about 419,000 shares of common stock in connection with the optional conversion of debentures.

TCF said there were $7.1 million in Great Lakes National Bank Michigan 7-1/4 percent convertible subordinated debentures due 2011. Earlier this month, Great Lakes said it would redeem the debentures at par plus accrued and unpaid interest to the date of redemption. The debentures were convertible into TCF common stock at $17.04 a share. The deadline for holders to covert the debentures was June 9.
TCF is a national bank holding company.
